sample_unit: synthetic multi-turn Q&A datasets (medical and legal)

links.outcome: Targeted PII reconstruction from LLMs fine-tuned on small proprietary medical and legal SFT data
links.effect: COVA consistently improves PII reconstruction over baseline decoding methods across datasets. Even limited contextual knowledge about a target user substantially increases adversary success.
links.quote: Our findings demonstrate that small, proprietary SFT datasets can induce meaningful privacy leakage through the reconstruction of target-PII associations learned during fine-tuning.

screen.reason: Empirical study benchmarking privacy leakage and adversarial reconstruction of PII from fine-tuned LLMs in medical and legal domains, but does not evaluate a specific health care deployment safeguard practice.
